<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אלול_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518920437_theRebbe_883" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_9C_D7_95_D7_9C_meluket__BH_POST_1766518920437_theRebbe_883__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section provides the opening header and date of the maamar.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">With the help of Heaven.</t>
    <t s="1">Erev Monday, Parshat Nitzavim-Vayelech,</t>
    <t s="2">18 Elul 5739*</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section indicates the maamar is an oral discourse.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">(An oral discourse)</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the verse "You are standing today" refers to a covenant before entering the Land, which applies to every Jew's service.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">"You are standing today, all of you, before Hashem your G-d: your heads, your tribes, etc., to pass into the covenant of Hashem your G-d, etc."1</t>
    <t s="1">And afterwards it continues2</t>
    <t s="2">(in the second portion,</t>
    <t s="3">the daily Torah study portion for that day)</t>
    <t s="4">("And not with you alone do I make this covenant, etc., but with etc., whoever is not here with us today")</t>
    <t s="5">"And you shall return"3</t>
    <t s="6">"to Hashem your G-d, etc."</t>
    <t s="7">Now, this portion is always read before Rosh Hashanah</t>
    <t s="8">(as the Alter Rebbe writes in Likkutei Torah4),</t>
    <t s="9">And the teaching of the Baal Shem Tov is known5</t>
    <t s="10">that "You are standing" is the blessing of the Holy One, blessed be He, with which He blesses His people, the children of Israel, on the Shabbat of blessing—the last Shabbat of the month of Elul—with the blessing of the month, the seventh month,</t>
    <t s="11">and through this power, Israel blesses the months of the entire year,</t>
    <t s="12">from which it is understood that this matter</t>
    <t s="13">(of "You are standing, etc.")</t>
    <t s="14">is a general matter.</t>
    <t s="15">And the explanation is:</t>
    <t s="16">Behold, the verse explains that this "You are standing today, all of you, etc.,"</t>
    <t s="17">all ten levels6</t>
    <t s="18">from your heads, your tribes, to your woodcutters and water drawers,</t>
    <t s="19">as one unified whole,6</t>
    <t s="20">is in order to pass you into the covenant of Hashem your G-d, etc., for before they entered the Land</t>
    <t s="21">(when this portion was first said)</t>
    <t s="22">there was a covenant made regarding the acceptance of the Torah, besides the covenant He made with them at Chorev,7</t>
    <t s="23">meaning that here it speaks of a special covenant made before entering the Land.</t>
    <t s="24">And since "Not with you alone do I make this covenant"</t>
    <t s="25">(but also)</t>
    <t s="26">"with whoever is not here with us today,"</t>
    <t s="27">it is understood that the matter of the covenant before entering the Land pertains to the service of each and every individual.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
